item.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat into Democrats' column
item.description: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has narrowly won Alaska's U.S. Senate race, toppling the Republican incumbent, according to a race call by The Associated Press.
item.content:encoded:
Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has narrowly won Alaska's U.S. Senate race, toppling the Republican incumbent, according to a race call by The Associated Press.

(Image credit: Justin Sullivan)

item.title: Families push more air safety measures as FAA grapples with system improvements
item.description: On the heels of an air traffic meltdown, families of the 67 killed in a mid-air crash near Reagan National Airport call on lawmakers to pass an aviation safety bill.
item.content:encoded: On the heels of an air traffic meltdown, families of the 67 killed in a mid-air crash near Reagan National Airport call on lawmakers to pass an aviation safety bill.

item.title: Air travel, Microsoft, banking: Why are our IT systems failing?
item.description: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer speaks with cybersecurity expert Dmitri Alperovitch about the coincidence of several major technical failures in IT infrastructure — and how best to understand it.

item.title: Take a look, it's in his book: LeVar Burton writes a memoir
item.description: The longtime host of Reading Rainbow is telling his own story. Burton opened a window to the past in Roots and helped imagine a different future on Star Trek. His new memoir is Take My Word for It.

item.title: Iran launches a third round of strikes on Bahrain, host of U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet
item.description: Iran fired drones on Tuesday at a U.S. radar facility in Bahrain, and the U.S. retaliated by firing at Iranian targets along an important shipping route.

item.title: Nvidia board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
item.description: The former Nvidia CEO said he would be "honored" to return if the board allowed. But the board says it has no intention of reinstating him.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Sen. Jack Reed says FAA needs a real plan, not just more money
item.description: Sen. Jack Reed raised concerns about FAA oversight of contractors after last week's nationwide ground stop and criticized the Trump administration's request for $50 billion in additional funding.

item.title: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip
item.description: Manila is President Trump's first stop on a three-day trip that will later take him to China for historic three-way nuclear talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
